caseNameFull: Charles A. Patterson v. Martha Isabelle Patterson
attorneys: Mr. Theodore Martin, Mr. W. H. Morris, Mr. S. M. Shipley, Mr. J. B. Yalsey, and Mr. J. F. Devin for plaintiffs in error. Mr. J. D. Fredericks, Mr. W. C. Mulléndote, Mr. B. C. Hanna, Mr. A. L. Veitch, and Mr. C. W. Lyon for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5, 6.
